Lantern does not bundle model weights in the APK.

The optional on-device model download is pinned to two Qwen3-TTS 0.6B Q4_K_M
GGUF artifacts from Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF at revision
968442208ea86f312b6b67ac8ef0c1b551967e35. The underlying Qwen3-TTS model is
published by Qwen under the Apache License 2.0.

Upstream model and license information:
https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base
https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS

GGUF artifact repository:
https://huggingface.co/Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF
